description.value: Pappa Leo's Pizza is a Lower Mainland pizza chain that has been locally owned and operated since 2003, with each outlet run by community members rather than a corporate franchisee. The brand is known for scratch-made dough and award-winning pizzas loaded with fresh ingredients, available for pickup or delivery. Touring cyclists passing through New Westminster can grab a quick meal with contactless payment options.

address.value: 450 East Columbia Street, Unit 102, New Westminster, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pappa Leo's Pizza is a real, actively operating takeout and delivery pizza chain with seven Lower Mainland locations, including one in New Westminster — consistent with the OSM address on East Columbia Street. Promotions valid through May 2026 confirm the business is currently open. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned on the website; takeout is explicitly confirmed by the business name and site copy.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'North Vancouver' but 450 East Columbia Street is in New Westminster, BC. The website lists New Westminster as one of its seven locations, consistent with this address — the community tag appears to be an OSM data error.
